description: See and steer WHICH documents are open, without touching their content. op=list answers 'what is open, which one is active, and does it have unsaved changes' — and it is the one document tool that works when nothing is open at all, so it is the recovery read after a 'No document is open' failure. op=activate switches the active document by name or id, which is how you fix having edited the wrong one. Read-only with respect to pixels; use ps_open_document to load a file and ps_close_document to close one.

id.description: Target an open document by its Photoshop document id. Unambiguous — prefer this when names collide.

name.description: Target an open document by its exact Photoshop name, INCLUDING the extension as shown in the tab (e.g. 'portrait.jpg', not 'portrait'). If two open documents share a name the call fails rather than guessing — target by id instead.

op.description: list: every open document (index, id, name, path, saved, active, dimensions) — safe to call when NOTHING is open, which is the point. activate: make one of them the active document, by name or id.

name: ps_document

path.description: Absolute path, or null for a document never saved to disk.

saved.description: False when the document has unsaved changes. Null when Photoshop would not report it.
